tools.name: funraise_list_supporters
tools.description: List supporters (donors) in the Funraise CRM, newest first as Funraise returns them. Filter by exact email or by records changed in the last N hours. GET /api/v1/crm/supporter.

tools.name: funraise_get_supporter
tools.description: One supporter: name, email, phone, tags, opt-ins, household, primary address, institution. GET /api/v1/crm/supporter/{id}.

tools.name: funraise_list_donations
tools.description: List donations (transactions) with amount, date, supporter, form, campaign page, allocation, fees and tags. Filter by an exact transactionId, by last N hours, or by a lastUpdated timestamp; use last_id to continue from the last donation id of the previous page. GET /api/v1/crm/donation.

tools.name: funraise_get_donation
tools.description: One donation by its Funraise id: amount, date, supporter, household, form, allocation, dedication, fees, UTM, subscription. GET /api/v1/crm/donation/{id}.

tools.name: funraise_list_subscriptions
tools.description: List recurring gifts (subscriptions) with status, frequency, amount, next payment date and supporter. The q filter is a Funraise expression (Funraise requires it; default: id > 0 order by id asc), for example: id > 10 and status = "Cancelled" order by id asc. GET /api/v1/crm/subscription.

tools.name: funraise_get_subscription
tools.description: One recurring gift by id: status, frequency, amount, last and next payment date, cancel date, supporter. GET /api/v1/crm/subscription/{id}.

tools.name: funraise_list_forms
tools.description: List donation and event forms, filtered by type, status and version. Needs the CREATOR role on the key. GET /api/v1/form.

tools.name: funraise_list_campaign_sites
tools.description: List campaign sites (fundraising pages), active by default or archived. Returns campaignSites with totalPageCount and totalRowCount. GET /api/v1/campaignSite/active or /archived.

tools.name: funraise_get_campaign_site
tools.description: One campaign site by UUID: configuration preview (payment options, goals, form, homepage, fundraiser settings). GET /api/v1/campaignSite/{uuid}.

tools.name: funraise_list_form_custom_questions
tools.description: The custom questions attached to a form. GET /api/v2/form/{formId}/custom-question.

tools.name: funraise_get_household
tools.description: One household: name, salutation, member count, primary contact, preferred address, total giving. GET /api/v1/household/{householdId}.

tools.name: funraise_get_household_member
tools.description: The household membership of a supporter (household and supporter details). GET /api/v1/household/member/{supporterId}.

tools.name: funraise_list_household_addresses
tools.description: Addresses of a household (paginated: list, page, pageSize, totalPageCount, totalRowCount). GET /api/v1/household/{householdId}/address.

tools.name: funraise_list_supporter_addresses
tools.description: Addresses of a supporter (paginated). GET /api/v1/supporter/{supporterId}/address.

tools.name: funraise_get_address
tools.description: One address by id (street, city, state, postal code, country, primary flag, household and supporter). GET /api/v1/address/{addressId}.

tools.name: funraise_list_supporter_notes
tools.description: Notes on a supporter's record (paginated). GET /api/v2/supporter/{id}/note.

tools.name: funraise_list_household_notes
tools.description: Notes on a household's record (paginated). GET /api/v2/household/{id}/note.

tools.name: funraise_get_note
tools.description: One note by id, with title, body, importance and author. GET /api/v2/note/{id}.

tools.name: funraise_list_supporter_interactions
tools.description: The interaction log of a supporter (calls, emails, meetings): subject, description, action, assigned user, dates. GET /api/v1/interaction/donor/{donorId}.

tools.name: funraise_list_user_interactions
tools.description: Interactions assigned to a Funraise user (staff member). GET /api/v1/interaction/user/{userId}.

tools.name: funraise_get_interaction
tools.description: One interaction by id. GET /api/v1/interaction/{id}.

tools.name: funraise_get_task
tools.description: One task by id: title, description, due date, status, assigned user, supporter, linked donation. GET /api/v2/task/{id}.

tools.name: funraise_create_supporter_note
tools.description: WRITE: add a note to a supporter's record in Funraise. Creates a new note each call. POST /api/v2/supporter/{id}/note.

tools.name: funraise_create_household_note
tools.description: WRITE: add a note to a household's record in Funraise. Creates a new note each call. POST /api/v2/household/{id}/note.

tools.name: funraise_create_interaction
tools.description: WRITE: log an interaction (call, email, meeting) on a supporter's record. Creates a new interaction each call. POST /api/v1/interaction.

tools.name: funraise_create_task
tools.description: WRITE: create a task in Funraise, linked to a supporter or to a donation (give at least one). Title is 40 characters at most. Creates a new task each call. POST /api/v2/task.

tools.name: funraise_complete_task
tools.description: WRITE: mark a task complete (sets the completed date to now; Funraise may also log an interaction if the task automation says so). PUT /api/v1/task/{id}/complete.

tools.name: funraise_create_supporter
tools.description: WRITE: create a supporter (donor) record in Funraise. Creates a new record each call, so search with funraise_list_supporters (email) first to avoid duplicates. POST /api/v1/crm/supporter.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: funraise_list_supporters, funraise_get_supporter, funraise_list_supporter_interactions, funraise_create_supporter · Private data: funraise_list_supporters, funraise_get_household, funraise_list_supporter_notes, funraise_list_household_notes, funraise_create_supporter_note, funraise_create_household_note, funraise_create_interaction, funraise_create_supporter · Public sink: funraise_list_supporters, funraise_get_supporter, funraise_create_supporter_note, funraise_create_household_note, funraise_create_interaction, funraise_create_task, funraise_create_supporter.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: funraise_list_supporters, funraise_get_supporter, funraise_list_supporter_interactions, funraise_create_supporter · Private data: funraise_list_supporters, funraise_get_household, funraise_list_supporter_notes, funraise_list_household_notes, funraise_create_supporter_note, funraise_create_household_note, funraise_create_interaction, funraise_create_supporter · Public sink: funraise_list_supporters, funraise_get_supporter, funraise_create_supporter_note, funraise_create_household_note, funraise_create_interaction, funraise_create_task, funraise_create_supporter

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
